question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**opportunity**" means a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something. (अवसर)
 
• In the context of student clubs, the purpose is to provide a chance for students to showcase their talents and capabilities.
 
• The other options:** "risk," "occasion," and "excuse" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The main purpose of the club is to provide a/an opportunity__ to showcase their talents and capabilities.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Risk (जोखिम)**: means a situation involving exposure to danger or loss.
 
• **Occasion (अवसर)**: means a particular time or event.
 
• **Excuse (बहाना)**: means a reason or explanation put forward to defend or justify a fault or offense.
